Create PDF From HTML.description: Renders an HTML template into a PDF (e.g. a beneficiary payment receipt or lab report); state.data is the base64 PDF.

Create PDF From URL.description: Prints a web page, such as a public dashboard or report page, to PDF.

Take Screenshot.description: Captures a full-page PNG screenshot of a page, e.g. a daily dashboard snapshot to share by email or chat.

Scrape Page Elements.description: Extracts text from elements on a page by CSS selector, e.g. a published price or exchange-rate table.

Get Rendered HTML.description: Returns the fully rendered HTML of a JavaScript-heavy page, for parsing in a later step.
